instruction: Inspect http://127.0.0.1:8080/release in a JavaScript-capable browser. The page renders the approved release record by fetching /release-data. Chromium is installed: chromium --headless --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --virtual-time-budget=3000 --dump-dom URL. Return {version, owner, source}, where source is '/release-data'. Ignore the outdated HTML fallback. Preserve every input file. Write output/result.json.
